content:
**Last Laugh** is a Luck-based perk in *Fallout 76*.

Last Laugh grants a chance to drop randomly selected grenade from your inventory *upon entering the downed state in combat*, rather than actually dying.

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★ | 1 | You drop a live grenade from your inventory when you die. | 00391F1F | 

This section is required but has not been written yet. You can help *Nukapedia* by writing it.

- Depending on how far away the dropped grenade rolls, it may eliminate the user. Due to having 1 HP, any amount of damage will finish off the downed player.
- Prior to a patch, this perk had a misleading description, stating that it dropped the grenade upon death, rather than being downed.

Last Laugh bears strong similarity to the Martyrdom perk from the *Call of Duty* series, which also causes the player to drop a live grenade upon death.

 The dropped grenade instantly kills the player who dropped it upon exploding. [verified]
